description: Find linked and unlinked mentions of a brand across the web via web search results. When a domain is supplied, classifies each mention as linked (on the brand domain) or unlinked (a third-party page — a potential backlink opportunity).

brand.description: Brand or product name to search mentions for.

domain.description: The brand's own domain (e.g. acme.com) — used to classify linked vs unlinked.

name: find_mentions
title: Find brand mentions
